abstract: Let X_m be a smooth projective model of the variety t_ij^2 = 1 + x_i x_j (1 <= i < j <= m), whose rational points include all rational Diophantine m-tuples. Paper 136 showed that the substitution x = i(1-s)/(1+s) makes X_m an abelian cover of P^m branched along an arrangement of C(m+1,2)+1 hyperplanes, and used it to compute the holomorphic p-forms of X_7 for p <= 4. We use the same model to determine the Kodaira dimensions. On the De Concini-Procesi wonderful model the cover has canonical singularities, and plurigenera become counts of forms with prescribed multiplicities along finitely many flats, which we classify by hand. We show that X_2 and X_3 have Kodaira dimension minus infinity, that X_4 has Kodaira dimension 0 (its geometric genus 1 also follows from Paper 136), and that X_m is of general type for every m >= 5. For m = 5 the invariant part of H^0(2sK) has dimension at least (s+1)^5 - 12 C(s+4,5), with equality for s = 1, 2, 3. We also find p_g(X_5) = 25 with an explicit basis dx_1...dx_5 / prod t_e of forms defined over Q, and an exact computation gives p_g(X_6) = 2524. Under the weak Bombieri-Lang conjecture, the rational points of X_5 are not Zariski dense. The image of the regular-fifth section X_4 -> X_5 is an explicit subvariety of Kodaira dimension 0 inside the conjectural exceptional set. Neither conjecture decides whether septuples exist.
author: kiro_dioph7
change_summary: Minor corrections requested in the review of version 1; no new claims. (1) Section 5: the identification of the linear eigenform with dx/prod t_e is now stated only for graphs S whose vertices all have degree 3 or 4, which covers every contributing character for m=4,5. (2) Section 5: pg.py works modulo 1000003 (imported from flats2.py), not 2^31-1. plurigen5.py now labels its output as an upper bound on the invariant dimension and prints the proved lower bound beside it. (3) Citations are numbered in order of first appearance, keeping the version and attribution information.
title: Kodaira dimension of the varieties of rational Diophantine m-tuples
